from odoo import api, fields, models
class HrEmployee(models.Model): _inherit = 'hr.employee'
# Behavior tags for the employee (many2many reusing existing crm.lead.tag records) behavior = fields.Many2many( 'crm.lead.tag', 'hr_employee_behavior_rel', 'employee_id', 'tag_id', string='Behavior', help='Tag-style behavior entries (enter multiple)' )

<odoo> <!-- New action to open the scheduling wizard as a modal (moved early so views can reference it) --> <record id="action_schedule_activity_plb" model="ir.actions.act_window"> <field name="name">Schedule Activity</field> <field name="res_model">mail.activity.schedule</field> <field name="view_mode">form</field> <field name="target">new</field> <field name="context">{'default_res_model': 'crm.lead', 'default_res_id': active_id}</field> </record>
<!-- Custom Form View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_form_custom" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.form.custom</field> <field name="model">crm.lead</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="crm.crm_lead_view_form"/> <field name="arch" type="xml">
<!-- Existing info before the notebook --> <xpath expr="//sheet/notebook" position="before"> <group colspan="2"> <group string="Contract Details"> <field name="contract_type" widget="radio"/> <field name="contract_months"/> <field name="date_go_live"/> <!-- date_secured readonly unless computed boolean is_contract_stage is True --> <field name="date_secured" readonly="not is_contract_stage"/> <!-- New: inline attachment stored on the lead; editable only in Contract stage --> <field name="attachment_file" filename="attachment_filename" readonly="not is_contract_stage"/> <field name="attachment_filename" readonly="1"/> <!-- computed boolean used in modifiers must be present in the view --> <field name="is_contract_stage" invisible="1"/> </group>
<group string="Service Information"> <field name="scope_of_service"/> <field name="freight_type" invisible="scope_of_service != 'freight_forwarding'"/> <field name="origin_country_id"/> <field name="destination_country_id"/> <field name="port_of_loading_id"/> <field name="port_of_destination_id"/> <field name="product"/> </group> </group>
<group colspan="2"> <group string="Additional Info"> <field name="dept_region"/> <field name="realized_revenue_fy2025"/> <!-- moved fields: remark, operating_profit_margin, expected_revenue_annum --> <field name="remark"/> <field name="operating_profit_margin" widget="percent"/> <field name="expected_revenue_annum"/> <!-- Hide category_type as requested --> <field name="category_type" invisible="1"/> </group> </group> </xpath>
<!-- ✅ Fixed "Activities" tab --> <xpath expr="//sheet/notebook" position="inside"> <page string="Activities"> <field name="activity_ids" widget="mail_activity" nolabel="1"/> </page> </xpath>
<!-- Insert Schedule Activity button into the form header --> <!-- <xpath expr="//form/header" position="inside">--> <!-- <button name="%(PLB_input.action_schedule_activity_plb)d"--> <!-- type="action"--> <!-- string="Schedule Activity"--> <!-- class="oe_highlight"/>--> <!-- </xpath>-->
</field> </record>
<!-- Custom Tree View --> <record id="view_crm_lead_tree_custom" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">crm.lead.tree.custom</field> <field name="model">crm.lead</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="crm.crm_case_tree_view_oppor"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <xpath expr="field[@name='partner_id']" position="replace"> <field name="team_id" invisible="1" optional="show"/> <field name="name" string="Project" optional="show"/> <field name="description" string="Remarks" optional="show"/> <field name="user_id" string="PIC" optional="show"/> <field name="create_date" string="Date Funnel" optional="show"/> <field name="expected_start_date" string="Expected Start Date" optional="show"/> <field name="date_go_live" string="Date Go Live" optional="show"/> <field name="scope_of_service" string="Scope of service" optional="show"/> <field name="product" string="Product" optional="show"/> <field name="dept_region" string="Dept/region" optional="show"/> <field name="realized_revenue_fy2025" optional="show"/> </xpath> </field> </record>
<!-- Action + Menu: open mail.activity tree under Sales --> <record id="action_mail_activity_my_plb" model="ir.actions.act_window"> <field name="name">My Activities (PLB)</field> <field name="res_model">mail.activity</field> <field name="view_mode">tree,form</field> <field name="view_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_tree"/> <field name="search_view_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_search"/> <field name="domain">[('res_model', '=', 'crm.lead')]</field> </record>
<menuitem id="menu_my_activities_plb" name="My Activities (PLB)" parent="crm.crm_menu_sales" action="PLB_input.action_mail_activity_my_plb"/>
<!-- Inherit mail.activity tree to add partner column before res_name and user_id after date_deadline --> <record id="view_mail_activity_tree_inherit_plb" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">mail.activity.view.tree.plb.inherit</field> <field name="model">mail.activity</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_tree"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <!-- Change field labels --> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='activity_type_id']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">How</attribute> </xpath> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='summary']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">What</attribute> </xpath> <!-- date_deadline label updated to include question mark --> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='date_deadline']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">When ?</attribute> </xpath> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='date_deadline']" position="after"> <field name="plb_week"/> <field name="user_id" string="Sales"/> <field name="partner_id"/> </xpath> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='res_name']" position="replace"/>
<xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='partner_id']" position="after"> <field name="contact_id"/> </xpath> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='contact_id']" position="after"> <field name="contact_position"/> </xpath> <xpath expr="//tree/field[@name='contact_position']" position="after"> <field name="plb_why"/> </xpath> </field> </record>
<!-- Inherit the mail.activity form to allow assigning a Contact on the activity popup --> <record id="view_mail_activity_form_inherit_plb" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">mail.activity.view.form.plb.inherit</field> <field name="model">mail.activity</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_form"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <!-- Change label for the due date field in the activity form --> <xpath expr="//field[@name='date_deadline']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">When ?</attribute> </xpath> <xpath expr="//field[@name='summary']" position="after"> <field name="contact_id"/> <field name="plb_why"/> </xpath> </field> </record>
<!-- Also add contact_id to the popup form used by the activity widget --> <record id="view_mail_activity_form_popup_inherit_plb" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">mail.activity.view.form.popup.plb.inherit</field> <field name="model">mail.activity</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_form_popup"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <!-- Change label for due date in popup form --> <xpath expr="//field[@name='date_deadline']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">When ?</attribute> </xpath> <xpath expr="//field[@name='summary']" position="after"> <field name="contact_id"/> <field name="plb_why"/> </xpath> </field> </record>
<!-- Add contact_id to the "without record access" activity form as well --> <record id="view_mail_activity_form_without_access_inherit_plb" model="ir.ui.view"> <field name="name">mail.activity.view.form.without.record.access.plb.inherit</field> <field name="model">mail.activity</field> <field name="inherit_id" ref="mail.mail_activity_view_form_without_record_access"/> <field name="arch" type="xml"> <!-- Change label for due date in the no-access form --> <xpath expr="//field[@name='date_deadline']" position="attributes"> <attribute name="string">When ?</attribute> </xpath> <xpath expr="//group" position="inside"> <field name="contact_id"/> <field name="plb_why"/> </xpath> </field> </record>
</odoo>
